    • Constructor Detail

      • SSEngineParam

        public SSEngineParam(int concurrency,
             int candidateCount,
             String licenseFile,
             boolean enableRotation)
        Constructs a new SSEngineParam with user-defined parameters.
        Parameters:
        concurrency - the number of CPU cores for SecuSearch Engine to use. If the value is set to zero, the SecuSearch Engine will use all the CPU cores on a system for the maximum speed.
        candidateCount - the maximum number of fingerprint search candidates resulting from a search
        licenseFile - a string containing the full path of a SecuSearch license file
        enableRotation - whether or not to allow any amount of the rotation angle difference between a registered fingerprint and a search fingerprint. If it is false, the maximally allowed rotation angle difference will be 45 in degrees. Otherwise, any rotation angle difference is allowed.
